national_news.title: Logo and Mascot Unveiled for 8th Khelo India Youth Games in Telangana
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya and Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy unveiled the logo and mascot for the 8th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games.
The tournament will be held across six cities in Telangana, featuring nearly 8,000 athletes competing across 29 disciplines (27 competitive sports and 2 demonstration events).
The Games aim to foster youth sports participation and support the national vision of 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat'.

national_news.title: Vice-President Highlights 12-Year Expansion Milestones in Higher Education
bullets: Vice-President CP Radhakrishnan announced that India's higher education enrolment expanded from 3.42 crore to over 4.5 crore students over the past twelve years.
Key institutional expansions since 2014-15 include universities increasing from 760 to over 1,400, IITs from 16 to 23, IIMs from 13 to 22, and AIIMS institutes from 7 to 20.
The VP also inaugurated the orientation program for the 17th Odisha Legislative Assembly, stressing informed debate and parliamentary procedures.

national_news.title: Key Milestones and Legal Frameworks of India's COVID-19 Response
bullets: India invoked powers under the Disaster Management Act, 2005 and Epidemic Diseases Act, 1897, while constituting 11 Empowered Groups to oversee medical response, supplies, and communication.
Key operational structures included the Joint Monitoring Group (constituted Jan 2020) and the National Operations Centre under the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC).
By December 31, 2025, 97% of the eligible population aged 12 and above received at least one vaccine dose, 90% were fully vaccinated, and 22.89 crore precaution doses were administered.

national_news.title: Overview and Key Provisions of the Forest Rights Act, 2006
bullets: The Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights) Act, 2006 (enforced Dec 31, 2007) has distributed 25.42 lakh titles across ~238 lakh acres.

Nodal implementation is led by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs across 20 States and UT of J&K for Forest Dwelling Scheduled Tribes (FDSTs) and OTFDs (residing for 75 years/3 generations before Dec 13, 2005).
Individual land rights for residence or self-cultivation are capped at a maximum of 4 hectares; titles are issued jointly to married couples, are heritable, but cannot be sold or transferred.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Participates in 23rd India-ASEAN and 21st East Asia Summits in Manila
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Manila, Philippines, to attend the 23rd India-ASEAN Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit.

During the visit, PM Modi viewed the Laguna Copperplate Inscription (dating back to 900 CE, written in Kawi script), the earliest dated document discovered in the Philippines highlighting historical Indo-Philippine ties.
The engagements strengthen India's Act East Policy and bilateral ties with ASEAN member nations.

national_news.title: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas Celebrated Nationwide to Honor Bhagwan Birsa Munda
bullets: Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas was observed across India to mark the birth anniversary of tribal freedom fighter Bhagwan Birsa Munda (Dharti Aaba).
In Jharkhand, new Eklavya Model Residential Schools were inaugurated in Gumla and foundation stones laid in Ranchi, alongside tribute ceremonies in Khunti.
In Madhya Pradesh, the Rs 1,353-crore Dahi Micro Irrigation Lift Project was dedicated to the public in Dhar district, while Manipur inaugurated its State-Level Tribal Cultural Festival in Imphal.

national_news.title: Press Council of India Celebrates National Press Day in New Delhi
bullets: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw addressed the National Press Day celebrations organized by the Press Council of India (PCI) at Akashvani Bhawan, New Delhi.
The official theme for this year's event was 'Journalism: Populist or Responsible', highlighting key media challenges including AI deepfakes, misinformation, and digital arrests.
PCI Chairperson Justice (Retd.) Ranjana Prakash Desai and I&B Secretary Chanchal Kumar stressed upholding journalistic ethics, fact-checking, and accountability over digital virality.

national_news.title: Indian Railways Approves Cross-Border Train Service Connecting Janakpur and Ayodhya
bullets: Indian Railways approved a new weekly train service covering a 604 km route to directly connect Janakpur Dham in Nepal with Ayodhya Cantt in Uttar Pradesh.
The train will run through key towns in Bihar and UP, including Jaynagar, Madhubani, Sitamarhi, Raxaul, Narkatiaganj, and Gorakhpur, linking major sites of the Ramayana Circuit.
The project builds on the 69 km Jayanagar-Janakpur-Bardibas railway project executed by IRCON with Indian financial aid of around ₹1,000 crore ($120 million) to boost cross-border connectivity.

bihar_news.title: RailTel Secures Contract for Smart Classrooms and ICT Labs in Bihar Colleges
bullets: RailTel Corporation of India secured a contract worth Rs 57.49 crore from the Bihar State Educational Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited (BSEIDCL).
The order entails establishing hybrid Smart Classrooms and ICT Labs across various colleges and universities in Bihar under the PM-USHA Scheme.
Additionally, contracts were awarded by Bihar Education Project Council (BEPC) for installing Smart Classrooms and Vocational Enterprises in schools under Samagra Shiksha.
